entities.summary: Marcel Maurice Carpentier was a French Army general who served in World War I, World War II, and the First Indochina War. He commanded the 2nd Moroccan Infantry Division during the Allied campaigns of 1944–1945 and later served as commander-in-chief of the French Far East Expeditionary Corps in Indochina from 1949 to 1950.
